title: Project layout and imports

spans.text: Separating modules, tests, and data makes even a small project easier to grow. Avoid filenames that shadow standard-library modules, and test package execution with python -m.

spans.code:
project/
  pyproject.toml
  src/app/
  tests/

python -m app
No program output: the commands and folders describe a project layout.

spans.text: Package structure makes code easier to reuse and test.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Do not name a project file after an imported module; Python may import that file instead.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
